messages:
Maya (UX): quick thought: what if we add a 'Condense output' switch on each invocation in the playground timeline so long tool outputs show a one-line digest by default. helps scanning when you9re iterating on prompts. feedback? Sam (DevEx): sounds valuable. do we keep cost/latency visible when condensed? Maya (UX): yes, plan is to keep metadata (tokens, ms, model) visible; collapse only the verbose payload. Jonah (Eng-ML): implementation note: we should avoid rendering huge JSON blobs in the DOM when condensed. store full output server-side or hidden and fetch on expand. also preserve KV cache references for reruns. Lily (Design): a11y notes: the UI control must be keyboard operable, expose aria-expanded, and have a meaningful label (not just an icon). color contrast for chevrons and focus ring id's. Carmen (PM): we9ll want signals: how often users expand, percent of invocations condensed, and whether condensing correlates with fewer support issues. can we emit events? Maya (UX): mock snippet (inline):```html
{summary} 3 lines collapsed
``` Sam (DevEx): backend work: endpoint to stream or return full payload on expand; front-end: persist toggle per-user in localStorage and expose a project-level setting later. estimate: 3 frontend days + 2 backend days + QA. Jonah (Eng-ML): also tagging runtime: when we defer fetch, ensure any PII redaction/filtering runs before returning payload for expand. Lily (Design): microcopy tweak: use 'Show condensed output' as primary label; tooltip: 'Hides large tool responses but keeps performance metrics. Click to reveal full output.' Also add an inline hint when a schema mismatch is detected: small red badge "schema mismatch" with hover explanation. Carmen (PM): rollout: feature-flag gated, start with 10% of dev teams, measure expand rate, accessibility feedback, and support volume. schedule a 2-week ramp if metrics look good. deploy-bot: feature flag queued: condense-playground-invocations -> staging. Sam (DevEx): dev plan: PR with minimal UI and mocked fetch first, then wire real endpoint. tagging @Maya @Lily for copy and a11y review. Maya (UX): small UX thing: when an expanded payload is re-collapsed, animate height to avoid layout jump. also add a brief inline toast the first time user uses condense mode explaining saved tokens. Jonah (Eng-ML): performance note: deferred fetch should still return within 200-300ms for decent UX; otherwise we need progressive loading. Lily (Design): accessibility checklist for the PR: aria-expanded, focusable expand/collapse, visible focus states, screenreader-friendly toast, and color contrast verification. Carmen (PM): please add analytics event names to the ticket (condense_enabled, condense_expand, condense_collapse). I can add schema. Sam (DevEx): starting work now, will open WIP PR later today. will include minimal telemetry hooks. Maya (UX): thanks all, happy with direction. I9ll upload a short GIF of the interaction and final microcopy here when ready. :tada:
